notes: Original Schedule TO-I (offer document) for an issuer cash tender by The Herzfeld Caribbean Basin Fund, Inc. (NASDAQ: CUBA) for up to 5% (302,216 shares) of common stock at 97.5% of NAV. trigger_origin=board_discretionary: the filing says the Board determined to commence the offer and states its purpose as a liquidity event at a price closer to portfolio value; no programme, settlement or activist agreement is stated. The press release says the offer was announced in a press release on August 20, 2021, supplemented October 4, 2021. commencement_date from the press release (doc 8, October 12, 2021, 'today announced the commencement'); the Offer to Purchase is dated October 12, 2021. Expiration (Initial Termination Date) November 8, 2021, 5:00 p.m. New York City time, unless extended (only one date stated). conditions: 'other' carries the asset-coverage condition (1)(c); Section 5 also has (2) tenders requiring disorderly portfolio liquidation with adverse NAV effect (other), (3)(c)-(e) banking moratorium, credit limitation, war or calamity (market_disruption), (3)(f) any other event the Board judges materially adverse (board_discretion). No minimum tender condition. The security is called 'Common shares of beneficial interest' on the cover and 'Common Stock' in Item 2 and the Offer to Purchase (a Maryland corporation). The cover's Rule 13e-4 checkbox appears unmarked in the text, but the form type is SC TO-I and the explanatory note describes an issuer offer. 6,044,310 Shares outstanding as of September 30, 2021; NAV $6.76 on October 7, 2021.
